title: Court filing alleges Zuckerberg approved training Meta's Llama on copyrighted works
summary: TechCrunch reports the authors' filing claims he gave Meta's Llama team the go-ahead, a claim not tested in court.

title: Free Software Foundation classifies the Llama 3.1 community licence as a nonfree software licence
summary: The FSF cites the licence's acceptable use policy and other restrictions.

title: Los Alamos National Laboratory partners with OpenAI to run GPT models on the Venado supercomputer
summary: Wikipedia's OpenAI article says the supercomputer is used for nuclear stockpile stewardship.

title: Mistral releases Mistral Small 3, a 24B-parameter model under the Apache 2.0 licence
summary: Wikipedia's Mistral AI article dates the release to January 2025.

title: DeepSeek releases R1 and R1-Zero reasoning models with open weights and distilled versions
summary: R1-Zero was trained with reinforcement learning alone; the Spanish Wikipedia article dates the release to 20 January 2025.

title: OpenAI, SoftBank, Oracle and MGX announce Stargate, an AI infrastructure venture of up to USD 500bn
summary: Reuters reports it was announced with President Trump.

title: Google agrees to invest a further USD 1bn in Anthropic, CNBC reports
summary: The new investment adds to Google's existing stake in the AI lab.

title: OpenAI releases Operator, an agent that uses websites to complete tasks, as a research preview
summary: Operator can handle tasks such as booking and shopping and starts with US Pro users.

title: Trump signs Executive Order 14179 on US AI leadership, after revoking Biden's AI order, and calls for an AI action plan
summary: The order directs a national AI action plan within 180 days.

title: DeepSeek app becomes the most-downloaded free app on the US iOS App Store as Nvidia shares fall sharply
summary: Wikipedia's 2025 AI timeline says Nvidia's stock fell as much as 17 to 18%, reported as the largest one-day market value loss of any US company.

title: Alibaba launches Qwen2.5-Max
summary: The model is announced on the Qwen team blog.

title: First International AI Safety Report is published by 96 experts, commissioned by 30 nations
summary: Chaired by Yoshua Bengio, the report assesses risks from general-purpose AI to inform the Paris AI Action Summit.

title: TSMC guides record 2025 capex of USD 38-42bn and expects AI accelerator revenue to roughly double
summary: At its investor briefing TSMC reported record 2024 results and said AI accelerator revenue reached nearly 15% of revenue in 2024.

title: Spain's PM Sánchez launches ALIA, a public open-source AI model family for Spanish and co-official languages
summary: The government made the first ALIA models available to all users and started pilots at the Tax Agency and in heart-failure diagnosis in primary care.

title: SK hynix reports record 2024 revenue of KRW 66.2tn and operating profit of KRW 23.5tn on AI memory demand
summary: The company said HBM made up over 40% of its DRAM revenue in the fourth quarter of 2024.

title: ByteDance releases Doubao-1.5-pro and cuts vision model prices, saying it used no data from other models
summary: Yicai reports the sparse MoE model is priced at 0.8 yuan per million tokens and the vision model at 85% below the industry average.

title: India's Finance Ministry advises staff to avoid ChatGPT and DeepSeek on office devices, citing data security
summary: An internal note dated 29 January warned that AI tools could put government documents and data at risk, Navbharat reports.

title: India's IT minister Vaishnaw says India will build its own LLM within about 10 months on a shared 18,000-GPU facility
summary: Vaishnaw said the government compute facility will be opened to startups, researchers and developers and that models should reflect Indian context.
